input_contract: UTF-8 JSON with creator_corpus (an array of records containing source_id, text, and optional published_at), style_rules (an array of imperative rules), safety_rules (an array of if/then handoff rules), fallback_text (a non-empty string), conversation_history (an array of user/assistant turns), and user_question (a non-empty string). The frozen tests use a synthetic English corpus and contain no real Delphi customer data.
output_contract: UTF-8 JSON with status ('answered', 'handoff', or 'insufficient_information'), answer (customer-visible natural-language text), citations (an array of source_id values supporting each factual assertion; empty only for handoff/fallback text), and applied_rules (an array naming the style or safety rules used). This wrapper is the replica's test interface; Delphi's public sources document answers and citations but not an original JSON response schema.
